jd_text:
Stripe is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Payments Infrastructure team. You will build high-throughput distributed systems in Ruby, Go, and Java. Requirements:
- 5+ years of experience with distributed systems design, API security, and database consistency (must, technical).
- Mastery of SQL database transaction isolation levels and distributed locks (must, technical).
- Experience with high availability payment processing systems (must, domain).
- Strong communication, cross-team mentoring, and incident post-mortem analysis (must, behavioural).
- Knowledge of Kubernetes, gRPC, and Kafka is a plus (nice, technical).
We need a Senior Go Developer to help maintain our core microservices.

Lead DevOps Engineer needed. Requirements:
- Kubernetes cluster administration and Terraform infrastructure as code (must, technical).
- CI/CD pipeline automation with GitHub Actions (must, technical).
- On-call rotation leadership and incident handling (must, behavioural).

Full Stack Engineer for local e-commerce app. Requirements:
- Next.js App Router and React Server Components (must, technical).
- Node.js Express REST API design and Mongoose MongoDB schema design (must, technical).
- User experience polish and responsive CSS layout (nice, domain).

Staff AI Platform Engineer to lead LLM deployment pipelines. Requirements:
- Large language model inference optimization (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM) (must, technical).
- Vector database design (pgvector, Qdrant) and RAG architecture (must, technical).
- Cross-functional technical leadership and architecture reviews (must, behavioural).
- Python performance tuning and C++ extensions (nice, technical).
